entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to an available agent.
Hello, you've reached VeloFit customer support. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Hi Charlie... I'm calling about my new VeloBand Pulse. I'm just... I'm so disappointed with it.
Oh, I'm very sorry to hear that. Can you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
It's definitely a technical fault. It's just not working. I've charged it completely, but it won't sync with my phone no matter what I do. I honestly think the one I got is broken.
I see. A device that won't sync is certainly frustrating. Just to confirm, you feel the item is defective?

Yes, I'm sure of it. I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for years and I've never had a problem like this. I was so excited, and I really needed this money back if it wasn't going to work out. It's just so disheartening.
I completely understand your disappointment, and I want to make this right for you. Let me just pull up your order information and review the policy. Can you confirm your last name for me?

Thank you, Ms. Peterson. One moment... Okay, I see the order here. You received it 13 days ago. Let me check our return guidelines... Yes, according to our knowledge base, all items are eligible for a return within 90 days of delivery.
Oh, really? So I can return it?
Absolutely. Since you're well within that 90-day window, I can go ahead and approve this return for a full refund right now. I do apologize that the device was defective.
Wow, that's such a relief. Thank you so much, Charlie. I was so worried I'd be stuck with it.

Not at all. We want our customers to be happy. I've just sent a prepaid return label to the email address on file. Just print that out, package the VeloBand back in its box, and drop it off at the post office.
I will do that this afternoon. Thank you again for being so helpful.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great rest of your day.
